## Contract review
Reviewed at 2026-10-26T11:06Z

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c4503e6c32c6af675e8c92b0d28b5e10de0b9fe5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md (445–455), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md (150, 158–159), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (122), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md (7), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS rows 403/1228/1270/1385, widest-row pin 2202, MAX_LINE_BYTES 2472)

Inputs read: card #25991 body and all 3 comments (triage audit 6412135551, claim 6413754385, os-dev-report 6414312556); PR #26067 object, file list (4 files, +7/−7, 1 commit), net diff; 44 check-runs on `c4503e6c` (26 success, 18 skipped by selector, 0 failure — `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, all four claim/close guards, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Test Core`, every `Type Check ·` and `Lint ·` lane success); the rules text on `origin/main` `bbf70614` (= the PR's base; the surface is byte-identical between the claim's premise sha `0d83ee8f` and `bbf70614`). Head-tree files read over REST at `c4503e6c`; no checkout, no build, no gate run.

### ① Derived judgments

Rule by rule, each against the maintainer's verbatim order on the card (「你应该自己创建定时啊」「为什么不是每小时」「立卡」), the triage boundary (project-seat form only; zero-output warning kept and scoped to fresh-session triggers; `send_later`-chain ban kept), the surviving skill text, `platform-readings.md`, and the ratchet.

1. `SKILL.md:71` — 「PR 订阅事件 + 每项目一个巡查 routine;⛔ 无自绑 cron、无 `send_later` 链」 → 「PR 订阅 + 每项目一个自建自绑的巡查 routine,默认每小时;⛔ 无 `send_later` 链」. RIGHT. 自建 answers 「你应该自己创建定时啊」, 默认每小时 answers 「为什么不是每小时」. The old `⛔ 无自绑 cron` clause forbade exactly what the maintainer ordered; its retirement is a correct retirement, not a loss, and the positive rule that replaces it keeps the scoping the old ban carried (一个 per project, 巡查 routine only — not a general licence for self-bound cron). The `send_later`-chain ban survives verbatim, and the sister ban 「⛔ 无 cron 链」 survives at `seat-lifecycle.md:96`. Dropping 事件 from PR 订阅事件 loses no rule: `PR 订阅` is the term the skill uses for `subscribe_pr_activity` (`execution-duties.md:157`), and the alternative payment (dropping 每项目) would have lost the one-per-project guard, which matters more once seats create the routine themselves. 120 bytes = the cap, not over it.
2. `seat-post-protocol.md:58` — 「由维护者在 claude.ai 的 Routines UI 创建…」 → 「Routine 席由维护者在 … Routines UI 创建…;项目席自建自绑」. RIGHT. The Routine-seat form is kept whole (the triage boundary: Routine seats untouched); the project-seat form is added as a scoped clause. 「随 Routine 所挂」→「随所挂」 loses nothing (the subject is the Routine). 119 bytes.
3. `seat-post-protocol.md:60` — 「会话内 `create_trigger` 的 Routine 拿不到 GitHub 工具、零产出」 → 「`create_trigger` 开新会话的 Routine 拿不到 GitHub 工具、零产出」. RIGHT, and this is the one place the triage audit's boundary could have been crossed; it was not. The warning is kept and narrowed to the new-session form, which is exactly the fact `platform-readings.md:446` records (「agent 建的 Routine 起的会话不带 `mcp__github__*` 工具」 — the session it starts, i.e. a new one), while `:449` records the complement (「自绑唤醒的是已存在的会话、工具已加载 ⇒ 上条的传输问题不发生」). The old wording was broader than the measured fact; the new wording equals it. The `⛔ 不把它当座位 Routine 在跑` tail survives. 119 bytes.
4. `seat-post-protocol.md:65` — 「档位与 cron 是维护者在 UI 上的可调项」 → 「Routine 席的档位与 cron 是维护者在 UI 上的可调项」. RIGHT. A project seat's cron is now its own, and `platform-readings.md:455–456` say a self-bound trigger keeps its session's tier and a UI-built Routine cannot be edited by an agent — the unscoped line would have contradicted point 2 after this PR; scoped, it does not. 110 bytes.
5. `seat-post-protocol.md:66` — 「协议文本 ⛔ 不复制其当前值,座位贴才是现状」 → 「项目席巡查默认每小时,放宽须有理由并写座位贴;协议 ⛔ 不复制当前值,座位贴即现状」. RIGHT. The old rule is NOT lost: 协议文本→协议, 其当前值→当前值, 才是现状→即现状 are byte-saving synonyms with the same meaning. The new clause is the card's point 1 verbatim (hourly by default; a lane may relax it with a reason, stated on its seat post). Stating a default beside 「不复制当前值」 is coherent: the default is a rule, the current interval lives on the seat post. The one added rule was paid inside the line it joined — real deleted bytes, not a re-wrap. 118 bytes.
6. `seat-lifecycle.md:96` — 每 2–4 小时 → 默认每小时, 「⛔ 无 cron 链」 kept. RIGHT. 118 bytes.
7. `project-forms.md:31` — 建 → 自建, 每 2–4 小时 → 默认每小时. RIGHT. The relax-with-reason rule lives only at `seat-post-protocol.md:66`; acceptable, since `project-forms.md:29` routes every seating through `seat-post-protocol.md` and 默认 marks the value as a default. 117 bytes.

Surviving text, read for contradiction (grep of the whole skill on `origin/main` for 2–4, 自绑, Routines UI, cron, 巡查/巡逻, `create_trigger`, `send_later`, 零产出, 项目席, Routine 席): no other line still says 2–4 小时, no other line says a project seat must not self-bind, no other line says the maintainer creates the project seat's routine. `execution-duties.md:158` (「项目席由事件与巡查 routine 唤醒」) agrees with the new `SKILL.md:71`; `:159` intervals are explicitly Routine-seat; `:150` (「trigger 流只留给定时/重复型」) is satisfied, a patrol being 定时/重复型. `dispatch-runbook.md:122` is the poke form (`persistent_session_id` to a named session, `fire_trigger`, delete after) — a different mechanism, not a second spelling of the patrol. `lanes/director.md:7` (直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron) is the direct-connect director seat, untouched and out of scope.

Platform facts: 自绑 as the diff uses it = a trigger that wakes the existing (creating) session with its tools loaded — true as written at `platform-readings.md:449`, with the cost (`:450` orphan on session death) and the remedy (`:451` delete old, recreate from the new session, never an orphan) already recorded; the diff's rollback line `seat-post-protocol.md:64` (`delete_trigger` + …) is the matching act. The governed text names no `create_trigger` parameter, so it makes no claim `platform-readings.md` could contradict (the parameter spelling in the PR body is addressed under ③).

Ratchet, measured from the head tree: line counts 319/91/96/54 equal the CEILINGS rows (403/1228/1270/1385); every rewritten line ≤ 120 bytes (120, 119, 119, 110, 118, 118, 117); each file differs from `origin/main` at exactly the cited lines (71c71; 58c58, 60c60, 65–66c65–66; 96c96; 31c31) — one-for-one replacements, no line joined, no re-wrap, no CEILINGS row moved (the diff touches no script). `SKILL.md`'s 37 lines over 120 bytes are all pre-existing table rows, structurally exempt, widest 341 = the shrink-only pin at ratchet line 2202. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success on the head is the gate's own reading and agrees.

### ② Semver level

RIGHT. The diff is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` only (4 files), which publishes nothing from any released package; `skip-changeset` is the correct label and `Check Changeset` is success. `Clause-②: no` is right — no published acceptance set, schema or `exports` surface is touched, no arm; the review tier is owed by the governed-rules face alone, which is why it is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and not the `Clause-②` declaration face. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right — nothing a metadata author can write changes. `size/s` and `documentation` labels match the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author confirmed from the PR object: `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, `type` = `Bot` — relay-written; the identity that produced the diff is the mode:subagent dev's branch, signed below. PR is draft (governed `.claude/**` stays draft for the maintainer's word), 1 commit, mergeable.

Wording choices (PR body):
- 事件 dropped from PR 订阅事件 — answered under ① item 1: no rule lost; the stated alternative would have lost 每项目. Accepted.
- Mechanism spelled by contrast (自绑 vs 开新会话), not by parameter name — right for the governed text, which then rests on `platform-readings.md:446/449`. ESCALATED as a gap, not a defect: the PR body's claim that `create_trigger`'s default mode (no `create_new_session_on_fire`, no `persistent_session_id`) fires into the calling session is recorded nowhere in `platform-readings.md` — `:445–456` record the behaviour of 自绑, and `dispatch-runbook.md:122` records only the `persistent_session_id` bound form — so a seat that goes looking for the spelling finds the poke form. One platform-readings line recording the default-mode fact once measured (the ui seat's hourly trigger is the candidate measurement) is a follow-up for the skills seat; the diff itself is right without it.
- Smoke-test and rollback lines (`seat-post-protocol.md:62–64`) left unscoped — right and desirable: a self-bound trigger is still proven by GitHub output on a manual fire, and 零产出即技术性失败 applies to it too.

Acceptance notes (PR body) and os-dev-report `out_of_scope_findings`:
- `project-forms.md:32` (director and triage seats may share one routine) — ESCALATED to the maintainer's read of this draft. After this PR the routine is self-bound, so a shared routine wakes the seat thread that created it and the other seat needs its own trigger or a poke; the line is latent, not contradictory (the woken seat can poke the other via `dispatch-runbook.md:122`). Outside the card's four lines and the card's 「two points, nothing else」; a follow-up card by the skills seat if the maintainer wants line 32 to say so.
- `seat-post-protocol.md:61` (model pinned in the UI; a Routine inherits the environment default) — answered: by position it is Routine-seat text after line 58's split, and `platform-readings.md:455` already records that a self-bound trigger keeps the bound session's tier. Residual ambiguity, pre-existing, outside the card's lines. Accepted as left.
- `execution-duties.md:158`, `dispatch-runbook.md:122`, `lanes/director.md:7` — read on `origin/main`; the dev's readings are correct (see ①). Accepted.
- The ui seat's trigger id as evidence — answered: the governed wording does not depend on it; the in-repo facts it rests on are `platform-readings.md:446/449`. Accepted.

os-dev-report `deviations`:
- Commit-trailer form (model-free pair per AGENTS.md / os-dev.md) — not a contract item of this review; the head's CI lanes are green. Noted.
- 事件 drop, and the relax rule living only at `seat-post-protocol.md:66` — answered above. Accepted.
- No empty-branch probe push (platform-designated seat-thread branch), pnpm install timing, worktree cleanup — process notes with no bearing on the governed text. Noted.

No flag is left unanswered; the two escalations above are follow-ups for the skills seat, neither blocks this head.
